messages:
Alex Chen: Deploy finished to prod (cluster-3) at 16:03 PT — tag=release/2026.3.1. Kicked off minute-zero smoke. @Ops Lead I'm handing off monitoring.

deploy-bot: Deployment release/2026.3.1 -> prod cluster-3 complete. 6/6 pods ready. CI checks passed.

Priya Patel: Running quick HTTP checks now — `curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .` shows status: "ok" from 3/3 endpoints. Latency looks fine.

Marco Ruiz: Checking logs for any spike in errors, tailing gateway: `kubectl logs -n prod gateway -l app=gateway -f --since=5m` — nothing unusual so far. No 5xx.

Jamie Lee: Canary metrics: 1% traffic route. 99p latency +15% vs baseline but p50/p90 stable. Marking watch flag.

Priya Patel: Quick smoke commands I ran:
```
curl -I https://api.redwood.example/health
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
Responses returned 200 and small sample generation looks OK.

Alex Chen: Thanks. Rolling window for rollback is 20 minutes from now unless we see regression. If anything >5% error rate or >30% latency regression, we rollback.

Ops Lead: A couple notes for on-call:
- If rollback needed, use `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --namespace=prod --to-revision=123` (revision pinned in runbook).
- Notify #incidents only if user-facing errors >0.5% for 5m.

Marco Ruiz: Saw one spike in model-serve pod where preloaded cache miss errors hit ~8% for ~45s around deploy; recovered. Keeping an eye on KV cache warming.

Priya Patel: Pushed a temporary config toggle to lower logging verbosity (to reduce I/O) — not code change, just env flag `LOG_LEVEL=warn` in configmap. No restart required for gateway.

Jamie Lee: If we need a hotfix, small patch is prepared: drop debug asserts in tokenizer init (branch hotfix/tokenizer-skip). Ready to cut and roll to canary quickly.

Alex Chen: Cool. Ops Lead — can you ack the monitoring alerts (Grafana + Datadog dashboards) and add the release tag to the watchlist? :thumbsup:

Ops Lead: Acked. Dashboards pinned, alert thresholds on 5m smoothed error rate. Will escalate if thresholds fire.

Priya Patel: Quick note — embeddings pipeline ingestion lag briefly hit 2min during rollout, now back to 20s. Will watch next 10m.

Marco Ruiz: Trace sample for a 99p spike attached to this thread (stacktrace truncated): `service:model-serve -> kv-cache miss -> refresh` — looks like expected warmup.

Alex Chen: TL;DR: deploy done, minute-zero smoke shows no blocking failures. 20m rollback window. Hotfix ready if needed. Keep chat updates lightweight here; ping @Ops Lead or #oncall if anything escalates.

Jamie Lee: I'll re-run canary load check at +10m and report results.

Priya Patel: +1 — continuing to poll.

deploy-bot: Canaries stable at 1% for 15m. No automated rollback triggered.

Jamie Lee: +10m check: p99 normalized, error rate 0.03% — looks good.

Alex Chen: Great, closing minute-zero watch at +15m if no other issues. Thanks all. :rocket:
